name: Prism Slime
desc: Legend says that the first element was once dispersed like light through a prism, until the Creator high above separated it into seven forms. Only then did life upon the earth gain fixed substance and shape. Only here, in this corner of the moon, can elemental forms taken from the mortal world be steeped in flawless source-light, allowing them to retrace their origins and return to the primordial state in which all things were one. Perhaps the primordial light said to reverse destruction works by the same principle.
